# avm — Any Version Manager

avm is a version manager (node, java, android, and plugins), alias runner and
env manager by PrajaNova. npm: @prajanova/avm · GitHub: PrajaNova/avm

## Config
- Project `.avm.json` (`aliases`, `env`, `tools`) overrides global `~/.avm.json`.
- Tool versions are also read from `.tool-versions`, `.nvmrc`, `.node-version`,
  `package.json` (`volta.node`, `engines.node`), `.java-version`, `.sdkmanrc`;
  the nearest directory wins, and `.avm.json` `tools` beats them.
  `avm which <tool>` shows which file won.
- A project's aliases/env and `.env` files are ignored until `avm trust`
  (hash-pinned; editing outside avm re-blocks). Tool pins always apply.
- Missing managed versions: `avm <tool> use` installs; plain `node` falls back
  to the system binary with a warning.

## Commands
- `avm init` · `avm alias add [-g] <alias> <command>` · `avm alias remove [-g] <alias>` (short: `avm -al ...`)
- `avm run <alias> [args...]` · `avm resolve <alias> [args...]` · `avm which <key>` · `avm alias list` · `avm env list` · `avm plugin list`
- `avm exec [--no-install] <tool@version>... -- <command> [args...]` (alias `x`) · `avm run <alias> --with <tool@version> [-- args...]`: temporary versions, no pin or lockfile changes.
- `avm install [--frozen]` installs selected tools without repinning. `avm plugin lock [--platform linux_amd64,darwin_arm64,windows_amd64]` writes `.avm.lock`; stale locks fail instead of drifting. Locking requires an updated native Node/Java plugin; Android/asdf currently support unlocked installs only.
- `avm env [--shell sh|pwsh|cmd]` · `avm env add|remove|list`
- `avm trust [path] [--revoke|--list]`
- `avm <tool> use|install|uninstall|list|versions` (e.g. `avm node use 20`)
- `avm plugin add|list|available|remove|update`
- `avm shims install|remove|path|activate`
- `avm plugin outdated [--json]` · `avm plugin upgrade [tool] [--bump] [--dry-run]` · `avm plugin prune [--older-than 90d] [--dry-run]` · `avm plugin outdated`
- `avm self-update [--version X]` (Homebrew/npm/cargo/Scoop: use their upgrade command); `AVM_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` silences the notice
- `eval "$(avm shell-init)"` (bash/zsh) or `Invoke-Expression ((avm-bin shell-init pwsh) -join "`n")` (PowerShell)

## Helping a user
1. Is it about aliases, env, tool versions, shims, trust, or plugins?
2. Read `.avm.json` and any version files; run `avm which <tool>`.
3. Explain local/global/version-file precedence, and whether the config is trusted.
4. Give exact commands to fix it.
